verdict.rationale: GitHub runs a first-party Marketplace app directory that lists community and partner integrations. Named third-party apps include Render, Lovable, GitHub for Atlassian, Slack, Shopify and mobile CI/CD tools, so the core of the story is clearly delivered. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the install/authorization flow for Marketplace apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of installing an app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install third-party integrations from a marketplace or app directory

citations.quote: Build on your workflow with apps that integrate with GitHub
Tools from the community and partners to simplify tasks and automate processes
Extend your stack with apps, actions, and AI models.
GitHub for Atlassian unifies data, automates workflows, and syncs development across GitHub, Jira, and your Atlassian apps
Build themes and headless faster with Shopify for GitHub. Connect any repository, then push to deploy
